acceptance_policy.camera_deadline_gate: deadline from image availability to reception of the last of 30 frames; incomplete images count as misses
acceptance_policy.noncamera_deadline_gate: per-packet latency from CreationTimeTag to receiver; packet losses count as misses

credit_service_audit.rate_reason_method: Infer gain/spend/freeze intervals from consecutive native simulation-time credit values; cross-check gate, implicit guard-band and PHY transmitting state. The INET internal isInterpacketGap state is not directly exported; negative sendSlope intervals include transmission plus interpacket gap, so individual boundary attribution is not claimed.

drop_reconciliation.limitation: drops.csv stores whole-run aggregates and first/last timestamps, not a warm-up-binned count; the scope delta is not silently called a measurement loss
drop_reconciliation.sca_scope: droppedPacketsQueueOverflow count with OMNeT++ automatic warm-up filtering; t>=warmup through drain
drop_reconciliation.timestamped_scope: droppedPacketLengthsQueueOverflow vector, independently split into measurement and drain after warm-up
drop_reconciliation.whole_run_scope: TrafficAudit queue packetDropped callbacks from t=0 through simulation end

evidence.gptp_send_log: compressed whole-run log; exact send counts only if parser matched events

gptp_send_events.window_note: measurement cohort is [1,31) s when the simulator log timestamp was parsed; unmatched timestamps remain unwindowed

postprocessing_audit_corrections.correction: Compare effective gate durations/offsets numerically after normalizing units and whitespace.
Do not require gPTP clock vectors in the C3-base control; validate its preserved physical-link state vectors instead.
Exclude superseded seed-41 runs from current calendar pairing and contrasts while retaining them in the audit ledger.
postprocessing_audit_corrections.evidence: manifest instrumentation_supersedes IDs and event-calendar signatures

postprocessing_audit_corrections.correction: Separate application gate outcome from queue stability; prior application_viable copied the validator's combined cell viability, which conflated application failures with nonstable queues.
postprocessing_audit_corrections.evidence: per-receiver gate results plus independently reconciled queue occupancy traces

postprocessing_audit_corrections.correction: Compute high-hard diagnostic failures from packet latency sample misses as well as reported miss counts, packet loss, image misses, and incomplete images.
postprocessing_audit_corrections.evidence: retained per-packet and image metric summaries

postprocessing_audit_corrections.correction: Re-evaluate C4_original's brake egress GCLs as scheduled gates; only C4_shared_SPbrakes has permanently-open SP brake exits.
postprocessing_audit_corrections.evidence: compressed SCA and compact gate state series

acceptance_policy.camera_deadline_gate: deadline from image availability to reception of the last of 30 frames; incomplete images count as misses
acceptance_policy.noncamera_deadline_gate: per-packet latency from CreationTimeTag to receiver; packet losses count as misses

credit_service_audit.rate_reason_method: Infer gain/spend/freeze intervals from consecutive native simulation-time credit values; cross-check gate, implicit guard-band and PHY transmitting state. The INET internal isInterpacketGap state is not directly exported; negative sendSlope intervals include transmission plus interpacket gap, so individual boundary attribution is not claimed.

drop_reconciliation.limitation: drops.csv stores whole-run aggregates and first/last timestamps, not a warm-up-binned count; the scope delta is not silently called a measurement loss
drop_reconciliation.sca_scope: droppedPacketsQueueOverflow count with OMNeT++ automatic warm-up filtering; t>=warmup through drain
drop_reconciliation.timestamped_scope: droppedPacketLengthsQueueOverflow vector, independently split into measurement and drain after warm-up
drop_reconciliation.whole_run_scope: TrafficAudit queue packetDropped callbacks from t=0 through simulation end

evidence.gptp_send_log: compressed whole-run log; exact send counts only if parser matched events

gptp_send_events.window_note: measurement cohort is [1,31) s when the simulator log timestamp was parsed; unmatched timestamps remain unwindowed

runs.queueing_time_scope: whole simulation; includes warm-up and drain
runs.raw_vector_retention_reason: compact evidence retained; raw vector not selected
runs.service_event_extraction_error: Inherited raw retention ran before the pilot event extraction; root VEC was removed. No packet-event series is recoverable from compact aggregates.

tas_gate_schedule.note: Gate-state vectors are expected only for scheduled TAS gates. Permanently open SP brake exits have empty schedules and are verified from effective SCA configuration; no transition vector is expected.

acceptance_policy.camera_deadline_gate: deadline from image availability to reception of the last of 30 frames; incomplete images count as misses
acceptance_policy.noncamera_deadline_gate: per-packet latency from CreationTimeTag to receiver; packet losses count as misses

credit_service_audit.rate_reason_method: Infer gain/spend/freeze intervals from consecutive native simulation-time credit values; cross-check gate, implicit guard-band and PHY transmitting state. The INET internal isInterpacketGap state is not directly exported; negative sendSlope intervals include transmission plus interpacket gap, so individual boundary attribution is not claimed.

drop_reconciliation.limitation: drops.csv stores whole-run aggregates and first/last timestamps, not a warm-up-binned count; the scope delta is not silently called a measurement loss
drop_reconciliation.sca_scope: droppedPacketsQueueOverflow count with OMNeT++ automatic warm-up filtering; t>=warmup through drain
drop_reconciliation.timestamped_scope: droppedPacketLengthsQueueOverflow vector, independently split into measurement and drain after warm-up
drop_reconciliation.whole_run_scope: TrafficAudit queue packetDropped callbacks from t=0 through simulation end

evidence.gptp_send_log: compressed whole-run log; exact send counts only if parser matched events

gptp_send_events.window_note: measurement cohort is [1,31) s when the simulator log timestamp was parsed; unmatched timestamps remain unwindowed
